area: game fix: Enter skipped the death cinematic and the debrief it precedes

find.report_claim: cycle 154 gated the restart on a run having ended and on the four-second victory banner having expired, and its notes treated the death debrief as immediately restartable
find.live_evidence: a probe pressed confirm one frame after a real death: _restart_ready returned True because sim.alive was false, so the game restarted immediately -- skipping the entire 3.4 s death cinematic AND the debrief showing score, kills and history. The victory path was protected for 4 s, so the two endings disagreed about whether their last shot may be dismissed
find.consumer_evidence: a player holding or mashing confirm while dying (common when firing) would never see the debrief, which is the only place the run's score, history and NEW BEST are reported

read: shooter/game.py _restart_ready and the update early return
killed: a fixed death-debrief delay in seconds: the cinematic already defines the window, and a second constant would drift from the authored 3.4 s
blocking restart whenever a cinematic object exists: a finished path stays referenced, so the guard must read done rather than existence
leaving the inconsistency and documenting it: the victory and death endings should treat their last shot the same way
analyze.survivor: require the death cinematic to have finished (or to be absent, when its build fell back) before confirm can start a new run, and update the tests that encoded the immediate-restart behaviour

fix.shooter: shooter/game.py _restart_ready now returns _death_camera is None or _death_camera.done when the player is down, with the docstring stating that both endings protect their last shot; tests/test_new_run.py gains _finish_death_cinematic and two tests (confirm ignored for 30 frames during the cinematic then accepted after it; a death with no cinematic is restartable immediately), and the three tests that restarted straight from death plus both integration tests now advance the cinematic first
